newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options on Bema Gold Corp May 8.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options on Bema Gold Corp May 8.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange said Thursday it will list options on the stock of Bema Gold Corp May 8.
The options will trade on the March expiration cycle, with introductory expiries in June, July, September and Decmeber. Initial strike prices are set at 5, 7-1/2 and 10.
TFM Investment Group will be the designated primary market maker, CBOE said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
